thought.text: App isn't coming up and cms went to 000 (killed when app's build started). Let me diagnose:

reasoning_content:
The app isn't responding at all, and cms=000 (it died). It looks like app's build is stuck / OOM, and cms also got killed. Let me check.

Wait — cms=000 but it was 200 a moment ago. So starting app killed cms (memory pressure during app's build). And app isn't coming up.

Memory available is about 1GB, but app's build needs about 2GB. And cms was killed.

Let me look at the log and check what happened.

action.command: tail -8 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/app.log; echo "=== app build proc? ==="; ps aux | grep run-executor | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2,int($6/1024)"MB",$3"%"}' | head; echo "=== oom recent ==="; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -i "killed process" | tail -2

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "tail -8 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/app.log; echo \"=== app build proc? ===\"; ps aux | grep run-executor | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2,int($6/1024)\"MB\",$3\"%\"}' | head; echo \"=== oom recent ===\"; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -i \"killed process\" | tail -2", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Diagnose app build failure"}
